blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense counsel spokesperson Michael Poa on Tuesday belied claims made by fellow spokesperson Atty. Paolo Panelo Jr. that he supposedly agreed with him that the Senate impeachment court’s ruling modifying the two-thirds conviction threshold against Vice President Sara Duterte was “just a farce.” Poa was referring to the remarks made by Panelo last Wednesday, Sept. 23 when he was asked about the contrasting statements between him and the defense spokesperson, especially as both of them serve under Duterte’s purview. On one hand, Poa refused to negatively categorize the court’s ruling, maintaining that the defense has no intention to […]...
